mainEntity.name: What is a mini tummy tuck?

acceptedAnswer.text: A mini tummy tuck is a surgical procedure that removes loose skin from the lower abdomen and may tighten lower abdominal muscles without repositioning the belly button.

mainEntity.name: How is a mini tummy tuck different from a full tummy tuck?

acceptedAnswer.text: A mini tummy tuck treats only the lower abdomen with a smaller incision, while a full tummy tuck addresses the entire abdomen and includes full muscle repair.

mainEntity.name: Is a mini tummy tuck safe?

acceptedAnswer.text: When performed by a certified plastic surgeon in a regulated medical facility, it is considered a safe and well-established procedure.

mainEntity.name: How long is recovery after a mini tummy tuck?

acceptedAnswer.text: Most patients return to normal daily activities within 1–2 weeks, with final results developing over 2–3 months.

mainEntity.name: Can a mini tummy tuck fix muscle separation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Only mild lower-abdominal muscle laxity can be corrected. Significant separation usually requires a full tummy tuck.

mainEntity.name: Can it be combined with liposuction?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, it is commonly combined for improved contouring when appropriate.

mainEntity.name: Does a mini tummy tuck change the belly button?

acceptedAnswer.text: No, the belly button is not repositioned.
